subject: ela
intro: Each item gives you two short informational texts about the same event or person. One is usually a firsthand account (a memoir or first-person report by someone who was there) and the other is an outside account (a biography or report written by an observer). Read both texts, then answer the question. Everything you need is in the passages.

items.prompt:
Text A (memoir by Lena Park): "I will never forget the morning we launched our weather balloon. My hands shook as I tied the last knot. When the balloon finally rose into the gray sky, the whole class cheered, and I felt my heart pound with pride."

Text B (school report): "On October 3, the sixth grade science class released a weather balloon from the soccer field. The balloon carried a small sensor that measured temperature. It reached an altitude of about two miles before the signal was lost."

What event do both Text A and Text B describe?
items.answer: Both texts describe the day the science class launched (released) a weather balloon.

steps: Find what both passages are about. Text A talks about launching a weather balloon and the class cheering.
Text B reports that the sixth grade science class released a weather balloon on October 3.
Both texts are about the same event: the launching of the weather balloon by the class.
So the shared event is the class launching the weather balloon.

items.prompt:
Text A (memoir by Marcus): "The day I caught my first fish stays bright in my memory. The line tugged so hard I almost fell off the dock. When I pulled the trout up, it glittered in the sun, and Grandpa laughed out loud."

Text B (newspaper note): "At the town's youth fishing day, eleven-year-old Marcus Reed landed a rainbow trout weighing nearly two pounds. The event drew about forty young anglers to Miller's Pond on Saturday."

Name one detail that appears in only Text A and is not in Text B.
items.answer: Only Text A mentions details such as the line tugging hard, almost falling off the dock, the trout glittering in the sun, or Grandpa laughing. (Any one of these is correct.)

steps: A detail that appears in only one text is one the other text leaves out.
Text A describes the line tugging, almost falling off the dock, the trout glittering, and Grandpa laughing.
Text B reports the youth fishing day, the weight of the trout, the location, and the number of anglers, but none of Text A's personal moments.
So a detail found only in Text A is any one of: the strong tug, almost falling off the dock, the trout glittering in the sun, or Grandpa laughing.

items.prompt:
Text A (first-person account by Aisha): "I planted my first garden last spring. I dug the soil with my own hands and felt proud as I pressed each seed into the ground. Weeks later, when green shoots pushed up, I shouted for joy."

Text B (gardening club newsletter): "This spring, club member Aisha Khan started a vegetable garden in her backyard. She planted tomatoes, beans, and carrots. By June, the plants had begun to sprout."

What topic do both texts share?
items.answer: Both texts are about Aisha planting (starting) her first garden in the spring.

steps: Identify the subject both passages describe.
Text A is Aisha's account of planting her first garden and watching shoots come up.
Text B reports that Aisha started a vegetable garden that began to sprout.
Both are about the same topic: Aisha planting her first garden.

items.prompt:
Text A (memoir by an astronaut): "Floating above Earth for the first time, I pressed my face to the window. The planet glowed blue and white below me, and I forgot to breathe. No training had prepared me for that wave of wonder."

Text B (encyclopedia entry): "The spacecraft entered orbit at an altitude of 250 miles. The crew of three completed 32 orbits over two days before returning safely to Earth."

What do both texts describe?
items.answer: Both texts describe the same space mission (a spacecraft orbiting Earth).

steps: Find the shared subject of both passages.
Text A is an astronaut floating above Earth and looking down at the planet during a space mission.
Text B reports the spacecraft entering orbit and completing orbits before returning.
Both texts are about the same space mission, when the spacecraft orbited Earth.

items.prompt:
Text A (diary of a young pioneer): "I am writing by candlelight after the longest day of my life. We crossed the wide river on a raft, and I was so frightened the water would sweep us away. By dusk we reached the other side, soaked but safe."

Text B (history book): "Pioneer families traveling west often crossed rivers on rafts. River crossings were among the most dangerous parts of the journey, and some travelers lost supplies or animals in the current."

Name a detail that appears in only Text A.
items.answer: Only Text A includes personal details such as writing by candlelight, the writer's fear that the water would sweep them away, or reaching the other side soaked but safe by dusk. (Any one is correct.)

steps: Look for details the history book does not include.
Text A describes writing by candlelight, the writer's fear, and reaching the far side soaked but safe at dusk.
Text B gives only general facts about pioneers crossing rivers and the dangers, not this writer's personal experience.
So a detail found only in Text A is any one of: writing by candlelight, the fear the water would sweep them away, or being soaked but safe by dusk.

items.prompt:
Text A (memoir by inventor Rosa Vega): "The afternoon my little machine finally flew, I could hardly stand still. I had failed so many times. When it lifted off the table and hovered, I clapped and laughed until my cheeks hurt."

Text B (biography of Rosa Vega): "In 1985, engineer Rosa Vega built a small flying device that could hover for several seconds. The project took her three years and many failed designs before it succeeded."

Which text is the firsthand account (the memoir) and which is the outside account (the biography)?
items.answer: Text A is the firsthand account (the memoir written by Rosa Vega herself), and Text B is the outside account (the biography written about her).

steps: A memoir is written by the person who lived the event and uses I and my.
Text A says "my little machine," "I had failed," and "I clapped and laughed," so Rosa Vega wrote it herself. It is the firsthand memoir.
Text B describes Rosa Vega from the outside, using her name and the year, without I or my. It is the biography.
So Text A is the memoir (firsthand) and Text B is the biography (outside account).
